# Return the CardDAV directory synchronously from create

Account setup needs the created CardDAV directory object immediately so it can select and use it. Directory synchronization remains asynchronous and emits addrbook-directory-synced later; tests wait for that separate event.

Scope: carddav.

Paths:

- `mail/components/accountcreation/content/accountSetup.js`
